bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/view/ (retained views, Stack, Form, ScrollView), springboard/ui/src/ (stack, table, collection, sidebar, constraint)
summary: BifrOSt has an imperative, retained-view toolkit with stacks, grids, forms, scroll views, source lists, tables and animation, plus Auto Layout style constraints. It has no declarative View protocol, modifier chain, state-driven body, shapes or custom Layout protocol.

features.note: retained imperative views, no declarative body or modifier chain
